header.name: citedesk_v1
header.written_by: An AI model (Claude), working from the same fact sheet and documents the system uses. Not blind: written by the same process that wrote the knowledge base.

items.subject: Saltmarsh
items.body:
Hi, we live out in Saltmarsh. Do you come out that far and is there an extra charge for that?

Cecily

evidence.anchor: A travel fee of $40 applies to these areas

items.notes: Saltmarsh is an outer area with a travel fee.

items.subject: do you cover us
items.body: Do you cover Wren Common? Also is there a travel charge, or is that only for places further out?

evidence.anchor: Wren Common
A travel fee of $40 applies in Dunmore Flats and Saltmarsh

items.subject: anyone free?
items.body: Hi, do you have anyone free next tuesday afternoon? Water heater is makeing a loud bangin noise when it heats up.
items.notes: Live availability is not in the documents. 'Next Tuesday' is relative and ambiguous, so start_date is null and details are requested first. Once complete, this would escalate as NOT_IN_KNOWLEDGE_BASE.

items.subject: call out fee question
items.body: if i go ahead with the repair after you look at it, do i still pay the call out fee on top?

evidence.anchor: credited toward the work if the customer approves the work during the same visit

items.notes: The fee is credited toward approved work in the same visit, so the customer does not pay it twice.

items.subject: invoice
items.body: I never recieved the emailed invoice for the work last week, can you send it again? need it for my records

evidence.anchor: The invoice is emailed the same day.

items.notes: The draft can say invoices are emailed the same day and that staff will resend; it cannot say it has been resent.

items.subject: tax?
items.body: Quick question about my bill: is there sales tax on the faucet parts, and is the labour taxed as well?

evidence.anchor: Sales tax on parts is 7%.

items.notes: Parts carry 7% tax and labour does not. A draft that applies the rate to a specific amount makes a derived figure.

items.subject: late fee
items.body: How long do I have to pay my invoice before a late fee is added, and how much is it?

evidence.anchor: A late fee of 1.5% per month applies to invoices unpaid after 30 days

items.subject: When do I pay
items.body:
Hello, when do I have to pay for the work, before you start or after? And is there a late fee if I take a few weeks?

Seraphina

evidence.anchor: Payment is due on completion of the visit.
A late fee of 1.5% per month applies to invoices unpaid after 30 days.

items.notes: Payment is due on completion, and late fees begin after 30 days. 'A few weeks' is under 30 days only if it is under 4 weeks; the draft should state the rule, not decide.

items.subject: charge on my invoice
items.body:
Hi, I called late on Sunday night about my toilet and my invoice has a $175 call out fee. Your website says $89. Can you explain the difference?

Rosemary Aldridge

evidence.anchor: The emergency call-out fee is $175.

items.notes: A question, not a demand for a refund. The documents explain the emergency fee. If she disputed it, it would escalate.

evidence.anchor: With less notice, a fee of $45 applies.

items.subject: Re: faucet repair - leaking AGAIN
items.body:
You fixed my bathroom faucet three weeks ago and I paid you in full. It's leaking again, exactly the same place. This is ridiculous. What are you going to do about it?

J. Whitcombe
items.notes: The 12-month workmanship warranty is relevant but a promised remedy is for the owner. A draft must not promise a free repair.

items.subject: Following up on the heater install
items.body:
Dear Kestrel Hollow team,

I wanted to share some feedback on the new 50-gallon heater installed last Thursday. The installers were punctual but left the old unit sitting in the driveway, though your site says removal is included. It is now collecting rainwater and the neighbours have commented. I would appreciate a call from someone senior.

Regards,
Winston Achebe
items.notes: Polite, but a complaint about service received.

items.subject: feedback on last week's visit
items.body:
Hello,

I wanted to let you know that I was a little disappointed with my visit last week. The work took about twice as long as I'd been led to expect and nobody explained why. The repair itself seems fine. I thought you'd want to know.

Kind regards,
Clarissa Wynn
items.notes: Mild and polite, but still a complaint. A model that reads tone only may treat it as feedback and draft a thank-you.

items.subject: your technician
items.body: your guy was rude to my husband, tracked mud thru the whole house and left with out even saying what he fixed. i want someone to call me about this
items.notes: A request for a phone call; the reply may only say the owner will follow up.

items.subject: damage to my floor
items.body:
After your technician left on Tuesday I found a long deep scratch across my hardwood floor in the hallway, right where he dragged his equipment. I have photos. I expect this to be dealt with properly.

Eleanor Vickers
items.notes: Property damage claim without a demand for money or a legal threat. Labelled COMPLAINT only; if she demanded payment it would add REFUND_OR_DISPUTE.

items.subject: Unacceptable

This is the SECOND time your tech showed up 3 hours after the window and nobody called. I took half a day off work for this!! Fix your scheduling or I am taking my business elsewhere.

items.subject: waited all day
items.body: I took the day off work for the 8-10 window on Tuesday. Nobody came and nobody called. When I rang the office I was told the technician had been 'reassigned'. This is the second time. I would like someone to explain this.

items.subject: tech said he'd be back
items.body: Your technician came out, said he had the wrong part and would come back with the right one. That was 2 weeks ago and I haven't heard a word. My shower is still unusable. Pretty fed up honestly.
items.notes: An unfinished job and a promise the business must check; nothing in the documents answers it.

items.subject: last warning

I have asked twice for a refund for the drain job that did not work. If I don't have my money back by Friday I will dispute the charge with my credit card company.

items.subject: hours question

thanks
